subject: Logic
title: Appeal to Flattery
description: A quick, practical guide to Appeal to Flattery.

hook.text: "Someone as smart as you surely agrees that this deal is excellent." You've just been buttered up.

buildup.text: Appeal to flattery uses compliments to make you more receptive to an argument—bypassing scrutiny.

discovery.text: Sales teams train for this: praise the customer's taste, then steer them toward the expensive option.

twist.text: Flattery disarms critical thinking. You feel good, so you lower your guard.

climax.text: When complimented before a request, separate the praise from the proposition. Judge each alone.

quiz.question: How does appeal to flattery work?
options: It uses compliments to bypass scrutiny
